notes: 2026 rate schedules, standard deduction and exemption credits are from FTB's October 2026 Tax News '2026 Indexing' announcement (CCPI inflation 3.4%); FTB says complete 2026 tables will be posted in late December 2026.
The 1% Behavioral Health Services Tax (formerly Mental Health Services Tax) on taxable income over $1,000,000 (same threshold for all filing statuses) is folded into the brackets.

Exemption credits are reduced for federal AGI above a threshold (2025: $252,203 single, $504,411 joint, $378,310 head of household; 2026 thresholds not yet published); phase-out not modeled. Dependent exemption credit ($491 for 2026), renter's credit, CalEITC and other credits are not modeled.
California does not conform to the federal QBI deduction or HSA deduction; California alternative minimum tax is not modeled.
SB 711 (2025) and SB 1435 (2026) moved California's general IRC conformity date to January 1, 2025 for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2025, with listed exceptions.

seDeduction.note: California starts from federal AGI (Schedule CA adjustments); the deductible half of SE tax carries through.

seHealthInsurance.note: Self-employed health insurance deduction carries through federal AGI (HSA contributions do not).

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) contributions deducted for federal AGI carry through to California.

qbi.note: California does not conform to IRC 199A; there is no QBI deduction on the California return.

localIncomeTax.note: No California city or county levies a personal income tax. Many cities impose business license taxes, some based on gross receipts (not modeled).

estimatedTax.threshold: Required if you expect to owe at least $500 ($250 married/RDP filing separately) for 2026 after withholding and credits.
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: Pay the smaller of 90% of 2026 tax or 100% of 2025 tax (110% if 2025 California AGI exceeded $150,000, or $75,000 MFS). If 2026 California AGI is $1,000,000 or more ($500,000 MFS), the prior-year safe harbor is not available. Installments are 30% (Apr 15), 40% (Jun 15), 0% (Sep 15) and 30% (Jan 15) of the required annual payment.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $70 Articles of Organization (Form LLC-1), California Secretary of State.
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $20 Statement of Information (Form LLC-12), due within 90 days of registration and every two years thereafter ($250 penalty if not filed).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: $800 annual LLC tax, due by the 15th day of the 4th month after filing with the SOS for the first year and every year thereafter. The first-year exemption applied only to tax years beginning 2021 through 2023, so a new LLC formed in 2026 owes the $800 for its first year. A sole proprietor without an LLC owes no annual tax.
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: LLC fee on California gross receipts: $900 ($250,000-$499,999), $2,500 ($500,000-$999,999), $6,000 ($1,000,000-$4,999,999), $11,790 ($5,000,000+); none below $250,000. No state gross receipts tax on sole proprietors.
